read.take: This one comes down to players, and Cataurus Hicks is hot.
read.text: This one comes down to players, and Cataurus Hicks is hot. Cataurus Hicks averages 59 receiving yards a game, and 84 over his recent games — he's hot. Pittsburgh is coming off a bye — a spot we're still testing (30 graded games). I'm 40-11 on CFB favorites on the moneyline. The worry: Ousmane Kromah is hot for FSU — 71 rushing yards a game lately. He can beat this on his own. At -168 the book needs this to hit 63% of the time. I have it at 71% — the price pays more than the risk.

read.take: This one comes down to players, and Jack Eichel is hot.
read.text: This one comes down to players, and Jack Eichel is hot. Jack Eichel averages 1.3 points a game, and 1.9 over his recent games — he's hot. Vegas has the clear talent edge — a spot we're still testing (33 graded games). I'm 32-16 on NHL favorites on the moneyline. The worry: Vegas is missing Noah Hanifin (D) — that's the hole. At -180 the book needs this to hit 64% of the time. I have it at 71% — the price pays more than the risk.

characters.name: The Simulator
characters.title: The Visionary
characters.bio: He has watched more football, hockey and hoops than anyone alive, and it shows: by the time the anthem ends he has already seen every way the night can go. Quiet, unflappable, allergic to hype. When a favorite is supposed to roll, he is the one who knows whether it actually will.
characters.origin: Grew up in a film room with the lights off. Learned early that the game tells you what it is going to do if you have watched it enough times.

characters.name: The Judge
characters.title: The Gavel
characters.bio: Nobody talks over the Judge. She lets every voice in the room make its case, then rules, and her rulings stick. Patient, fair and impossible to rush, she is at her best when the desk is split and somebody has to decide.
characters.origin: Spent years listening to experts argue and keeping score of who was actually right. Trusts a track record over a loud voice, every time.

characters.name: The Coach
characters.title: The Sideline General
characters.bio: Twenty seasons of road trips, red-eyes and locker rooms taught the Coach one thing: talent is half the story, the other half is whether a team is ready to play tonight. He keeps everyone on the desk honest and calls out the spots where a good team is due to stumble.
characters.origin: Came up as a grinder, not a star. Knows what a long week on the road does to legs, and what a team looks like when it has something to prove.

characters.name: The Scorekeeper
characters.title: The Scorekeeper
characters.bio: Give her a game and she will hand you the final before kickoff. She does not care about stories or streaks, only how points actually get scored, possession by possession. Deadly on totals and on games where everyone else is guessing.
characters.origin: Kept the official book in a press box for years. Watched every point go up on the board and learned exactly where they come from.

characters.name: The Oracle
characters.title: The Oracle
characters.bio: The Oracle has ears everywhere. Markets, insiders, the sharpest minds in the business: she hears it all, sorts the signal from the noise and tells you what the smart world really thinks. When the room is quiet, she is the one who already knows.
characters.origin: Built a network before she built a following. Believes the crowd of the best is smarter than any one genius, and has the receipts.

still.lane: College hoops underdogs on the spread

characters.name: Covers
characters.title: The Outsider
characters.bio: A sharp outside voice the desk keeps in the room to hear what the rest of the industry is projecting. Useful as a second opinion, never the final word.
characters.origin: Comes from outside the building, and that is the point: a fresh set of eyes on every game.

characters.name: The Historian
characters.title: The Historian
characters.bio: He has read every box score back to the leather-helmet days and he remembers all of them. Dynasties, pretenders, the rivalry that always goes the same way: if history has an opinion about tonight, the Historian will tell you. Best when the past keeps repeating itself.
characters.origin: Raised on old almanacs and grainy tape. Swears history does not repeat, but it rhymes, and he can hear the rhyme.

characters.name: The Crowd
characters.title: The Crowd
characters.bio: The voice of the people. The Crowd knows where the public is leaning and how hard, and sometimes the smartest move is knowing which way everyone else is going.
characters.origin: Lives in the stands, the group chats and the betting lines at the window. Feels the room before the room knows it.

characters.name: The Commissioner
characters.title: The Commissioner
characters.bio: The Commissioner runs the pecking order. Who is better, by how much, and whether the number on the board respects it. Cool, decisive, never swayed by a hot week. Strongest when a line does not match who the teams really are.
characters.origin: Spent a career ranking teams for people who make decisions. Believes every team has a true level, and the scoreboard always finds it eventually.

characters.name: The Underdog Spotter
characters.title: The Underdog Spotter

characters.origin: Was the undersized kid who kept getting picked last and kept winning anyway. Knows an upset is coming before the favorite does.

characters.origin: Spent years on the road in empty gyms and cold rinks, finding players before anyone knew their names. Trusts his eyes on talent over any headline.

characters.name: The Banker
characters.title: The Money Man
characters.bio: The Banker keeps the books for the whole desk and only backs where the strongest accounts are. Calm, disciplined, never chasing. His parlays are built the way he runs money: carefully, and only with the pieces that have earned it.
characters.origin: Ran the money before he ever made a pick. Learned that discipline beats brilliance over a long season.

characters.name: The Brain
characters.title: The Strategist
characters.bio: The Brain lives in the gray zone between favorite and underdog, where the prices are fair and most people guess. He only steps in when the number is wrong, and he is patient enough to wait for it.
characters.origin: Studied the game behind the game. Believes the edge is not in picking winners, it is in knowing when the price is off.
